      A hundred years, one promise

      Panachand Zaverdas & Sons has fed Ahmedabad families for four generations. The name on the sign has stayed the same, so has what it stands for.

      1925

      The first sack

      Panachand Zaverdas opens a small grain store, weighing every order by hand and building a name for honesty.

      1950s–60s

      A city trusts us

      The second generation expands the range, pulses, oils, spices, and Panachand Zaverdas & Sons becomes a household name across Ahmedabad.

      1980s–2000s

      Bodakdev, and bulk supply

      The third generation moves the shop to Bodakdev and starts serving shops, kitchens, and tiffin services at scale.

      2026

      Online, without losing what matters

      The fourth generation brings Panachand Zaverdas & Sons online, same weight, same quality, same fair price, just easier to reach.

      The values behind the ledger

      Every item checked by hand

      Before anything leaves our shop, online order or in person, someone from our family or trained staff has checked it.

      No hidden weight, no hidden price

      The price you see is the price you pay. No surprise charges for ordering by phone.

      A human always answers

      When you call, a real person from the shop answers.

      Built for regulars and businesses alike

      Whether it's your monthly staples or a standing order for your kitchen, we treat both with the same care.
